Attach a classifier head to a pre-trained encoder

Source: R/classify.R
build_pretrained_classifier.Rd

Deep-copies the encoder so each fold gets its own independent weights (prevents cross-fold leakage when unfreeze_last_block = TRUE), then adds a readout that turns the (B, C, h, w) feature map into a vector, followed by dropout + linear classifier.

Usage

build_pretrained_classifier(
  encoder,
  num_classes = 2L,
  dropout_p = 0.3,
  freeze_backbone = TRUE,
  unfreeze_last_block = TRUE,
  readout = c("gap", "attention", "presence"),
  presence_head = NULL,
  n_queries = 4L
)

Arguments

encoder

A pre-trained dms_encoder.

num_classes

Number of output classes (default 2).

dropout_p

Dropout probability before the linear layer.

freeze_backbone

If TRUE, encoder weights are not updated.

unfreeze_last_block

If TRUE, the encoder's last residual block (layer3) is set trainable even if freeze_backbone = TRUE.

readout

One of "gap" (default), "attention", "presence".

presence_head

Required when readout = "presence": the presence_head returned by pretrain_denoising_online() (or loaded from its *_presence_head.pt).

n_queries

Number of queries for readout = "attention".

Value

An instantiated torch module.

Details

Readouts:

  • "gap": global average pooling (the original readout). Averages over all of RT x CV, so it discards where activation occurred.

  • "attention": attention_pool_readout() — n_queries learned queries with 2D positional encoding, trained end-to-end. Works with any existing encoder.

  • "presence": a pretrained dms_presence_head() producing one logit per catalog compound; the classifier is then a linear model over compound presence evidence. The head is deep-copied and follows freeze_backbone (frozen by default).
